sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Have the group ready before the quest hand-in starts the escort.
Clear the three guards and soulstealer promptly; the room-clear stage has a five-minute limit.
Stay with Trondol until his final stop and complete the follow-up hand-in promptly.
